desc: The innovative field spade for the 21st century with many intelligent details. The surface-treated spade blade can be locked in three positions for different uses. The spade can be easily turned into a shovel or a hoe. The hardened saw blade in the handle can be quickly mounted if required. Folded, up the GLOCK field spade can be easily accommodated in any field backpack or vehicle trunk. A must for any outdoor professional.
